capabilities: create marimo notebook .py files from a template
open .py files in the embedded marimo editor
run notebooks as apps in an output-only view
diagnose marimo and Python executable resolution
extras: Desktop only, since the plugin spawns local child processes; mobile is unsupported. Unofficial and not affiliated with the marimo project. Servers bind to 127.0.0.1 only, and the plugin can auto-install marimo via pip with user approval.
problem: Obsidian only opens Markdown files and hides everything else, so .py marimo notebooks in a vault cannot be opened or run from within the app.

relations.evidence: Unofficial. This is a community-built integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the marimo project.

requires.name: Python 3 with the marimo package (the plugin can install marimo via pip)

summary: Runs marimo reactive Python notebooks inside Obsidian by registering .py files and embedding a local marimo editor or app view in a pane.
